[[File:NarglatchCaveInterior.jpg|225px|thumb|The interior of the Narglatch Cave]]
The '''Narglatch Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located in the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]]. It was teeming with a colony of [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]].<ref name="SWG:NC" /> The narglatches had been set up in the cave by [[Rescue Our Lesser Brothers]], an organization dedicated to the protection of endangered species, so the beast could breed without being threatened.<ref name="SWG:ac2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Endor}}</ref> Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a commoner barely escaped from the creatures while wandering past the cave. When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] later met the commoner in Moenia, they agreed to provide the cave's location.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Narglatch Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
